# discord_invite (Data Source)

Resolves an invite code to the server and channel it leads to. Works for invites to servers the bot is not a member of.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_invite" "partner" {
  code = var.invite_code
}

output "partner_server" {
  value = "${data.discord_invite.partner.server_name} (${data.discord_invite.partner.approximate_member_count} members)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Invite code, the part after `https://discord.gg/`.

### Optional

- `scheduled_event_id` (String) ID of a scheduled event to resolve the invite for.

### Read-Only

- `approximate_member_count` (Number) Approximate number of members of the server.
- `approximate_presence_count` (Number) Approximate number of online members of the server.
- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the invite is for.
- `channel_name` (String) Name of the channel the invite is for.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite expires, or null if it never does.
- `inviter_id` (String) ID of the user who created the invite.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server the invite is for.
- `server_name` (String) Name of the server the invite is for.
- `target_type` (String) For voice channel invites, what the invite opens: `stream`, `embedded_application`.
- `target_user_id` (String) ID of the user whose stream the invite opens.
- `type` (String) Invite type: `guild`, `group_dm`, `friend`.
